`create_model` leaves `sns` as the MultiIndex returned by `as_index` and passes it unchanged to the variable and constraint builders, including both loss-constraint modes. Although it flattens the model parameter and component data when requested, it never converts the snapshot index passed to those builders, so the criterion fails for multi-period networks with `"flat"` or `"auto"` under v1 semantics.
